name: cpu-temp
title: CPU Temperature
author: bespoked
description: Adds the printer's Rockchip CPU as a Klipper temperature_sensor so its temperature shows up in the web UI alongside the hotend and bed. Read-only monitoring, no fan control. Works only on the Rockchip-based Snapmaker U1.
tagline: Show the Rockchip SoC temperature in Fluidd & Mainsail.
attributions:
# Attributions - cpu-temp

**Plugin author:** Bespok3d

Shows the mainboard CPU temperature in the web interface.

No third-party code ships in this package.
